critical_code_review_comments: INCONSISTENCY (latent bug): ServiceType enum in /app/backend/models/enums.py uses 'design' while pricing library services.available_service_types uses 'graphic_design' as the key. Sending service_type='graphic_design' via /api/pricing/calculate is rejected by Pydantic enum validation with a 500 'Calculation error'. The 19 library keys should all exist in the enum (or vice versa). Currently 'graphic_design' is unreachable from the frontend service-type selector unless the UI sends 'design' instead. Recommend aligning enum values with library keys: add GRAPHIC_DESIGN='graphic_design' (or rename library key to 'design').

Unknown-service fallback only triggers for service_type values that ARE valid ServiceType enum members but NOT in the library (e.g. 'travel', 'other_labor'). For truly unknown strings Pydantic rejects before fallback runs. Documented but still works for the 2 enum-only values.

PricingCalculator.js continues to grow — after Services it likely exceeds 3500+ lines. Strongly recommend splitting each category into its own component file (e.g. ServicesCard.js) for maintainability.
Spec mentioned '24+ svc-* test IDs' — 23 found. Main-agent spec list is 23 (no separate svc-service-type-label etc.). Minor inconsistency with docs; functionality intact.
